package.author: Mikey Lee
package.description: Open-source desktop workstation for finding videos, translating and editing subtitles, dubbing, and export.

en-US.author: Mikey Lee
en-US.description: Open-source desktop workstation for finding videos, translating and editing subtitles, dubbing, and export.
en-US.longDescription: Translator keeps video discovery, downloads, transcription, subtitle translation and review, styling, dubbing, and export together in a multi-tab desktop workspace.
en-US.name: Translator
en-US.releaseNotes:
- "Current subtitle" now works while editing: it jumps to the line that's playing and keeps the header in view.
- Translate missing lines from here: fill a gap from the playing line (or any untranslated line) up to the next translated one, or all missing lines. Lines that are already translated are never changed.
- Videos from TikTok and other sites now play in Translator; videos in formats the player can't show are converted automatically.
- Posts that need you to sign in (Instagram, Reddit) now say so clearly.
- When choosing a video in the built-in browser, ads and short placeholder clips are skipped.
